rules: TS_DELTA($operating_margin, 63) failed cheap_screen in all 4 attempts where it was multiplied or divided against a price/volume term (|t| 0.02-0.58), even with one leg ranked or z-scored. It only passed added/subtracted against another fundamental's TS_DELTA inside a shared CS_RANK (fitness 0.060).

TS_RANK($dollar_volume, w) stays mutually correlated (rho 0.94+) across w=5, 21, 63 no matter the outer wrapper (ratio denominator or CS_RANK product). Treat the whole window family as saturated, not just the archived window.

Multiplying two bare cross-sectional ranks of fundamental levels with no TS-windowed leg on either side fails cheap_screen (RANK($roa)*RANK($accrual_gap), |t| 0.28). A multiplicative combinator needs at least one TS-windowed leg, even fundamental x fundamental.

Fundamental-delta windows of 84-94 days failed cheap_screen (|t| 0.25, 0.50), worse than the 42-63 day windows behind every fundamental accept this round. That is a dead zone between the 63-day sweet spot and the 126+ range that fails on coverage instead.
Dividing a fundamental delta by a raw price level ($close) before ranking erased the signal (|t| 0.10). Cross-sectional variance in price level dominates the ratio and swamps the fundamental term.

Flipping only the top-level +/- combinator while leaving both child subtrees untouched still reads as the same archive member (10 shared nodes). A combinator swap needs a change inside at least one child to count as a new fusion.

RANK(fundamental level) - RANK($dollar_volume) was this round's strongest and simplest kernel (fitness 6.115, medium/mixed niche). earnings_per_share now joins accrual_gap/roa as a fundamental that pairs well against a raw dollar_volume level in a plain rank spread.

$accrual_gap paired additively with a second fundamental's TS-derived leg accepted twice this round at strong fitness (leverage-volatility 3.558, book_per_share-delta 5.152), a reliable anchor for slow/fundamental rank-spread proposals.
